supported_candidate_denominator_descript: Five requested final evaluation slots per starting molecule; unavailable slots are retained in the denominator and count as zero successes.
interpretation: The archived experiment supports a common final evaluation-slot protocol, not a common whole-process computational budget. Raw search effort differs between methods/seeds, complete main/aux/native model-call counts were not historically logged, and only REINVENT4 has direct native-generation wall-time records. The shared property endpoint was archived only for the final locked layer, so a cumulative shared-call success curve cannot be reconstructed without new post hoc scoring.
